column3: “Causing to stray” is rendered “destroying,” and “flock” as “sheep.”
“Which anyone will call him” is rendered “by which He will be called.”
“Dried up” is rendered “mourns”; the verb has both senses.
“Deluding you” is rendered “leading you into futility.”
“His word” is the reading tradition; the written text has “my word.”
“On the prophets” is rendered “against the prophets.”
